name: superdev
description: 21 skills + 60 agents for full-stack monorepo builds. Direct sequential builds: the main agent builds directly with superdev-build (plan on disk, stack choice Nest.js/Laravel x Next.js/Inertia, contracts first, then one module at a time — backend, boot-the-dist runtime verify, frontend, browser verify), backed by standalone recipe and audit skills (design-to-nextjs, design-to-laravel, nestjs-enterprise-backend, laravel-enterprise-backend, laravel-bref-deploy, security-review-and-fix, exploratory-qa, systematic-debugging, product-completeness-audit, production-readiness-audit, brutal-exhaustive-audit, frontend-modular-architecture, frontend-refactoring, prototype-to-saas, design-preservation, superdev-self-learning, superdev-done), hard rules distilled from real build failures (dead-on-arrival dist under green tests, ESM contracts, patchNestJsSwagger boot crash, @Audit on the wrong handler, parallel contract races, dev-default secrets, Radix code on Base UI shadcn), and a cross-platform verify-done script that runs the checks live instead of reading a self-graded ledger. Workspace-scope and package-manager agnostic. v2.1 adds design-to-tauri (Tauri desktop/Android/iOS clients, locked-down shell, emulator QA), security-foundation (sessions checked per request, refresh theft detection, TOTP/recovery codes/passkeys/devices, staff permissions with masked personal data, per-account balance locks, idempotency, transactional live updates) and release-qa-gate (every route x role x viewport x theme, contrast in every state, dead links, device pass, evidence-cited QA_COVERAGE.md); verify-done gains Tauri shell checks and --suites.
